title: Malicious code in gloglet (npm)
description: The npm package 'gloglet' contains malicious code that compromises any computer on which it is installed or running. Installation of this package may lead to full system compromise, including unauthorized access to secrets and keys stored on the affected machine. Immediate removal of the package is recommended, but complete remediation may require rotating all secrets and keys from a separate, uncompromised device due to potential persistent control by attackers.
